purpose: Incremental official-source evidence for the final six IDs in the current 100-item unverified affiliate-audit target list that were not already covered by prior audit evidence or dedicated individual application/result records. Research only; no application, account enrollment, legal acceptance, payment, or new queue UUID is created.

entries.commission: 40% lifetime commission on premium-plan purchases made by referred users, plus 20% on eligible LinkedIn Automation add-on purchases
entries.attribution_note: Snov.io's current knowledge-base article says the referral cookie remains active until the referred visitor completes registration rather than stating a fixed number of days.
entries.payout_terms: PayPal withdrawals with no minimum cash-out amount according to the current official knowledge base.
entries.eligibility: Current official material says the affiliate program is open to everyone, with applications reviewed before the applicant officially becomes an affiliate.
entries.legal_consent_note: Snov.io's current knowledge-base article explicitly says signing up for the Affiliate Program means agreeing to its Terms and Conditions. No application or acceptance was performed; any later submission must stop for human approval if acceptance is forced.
entries.evidence_summary: Snov.io currently operates an active affiliate program paying 40% lifetime on premium-plan purchases, with 20% on eligible LinkedIn Automation add-ons, unlimited eligible referrals/purchases, and no minimum PayPal withdrawal.

entries.commission: 30% commission on referred-user payments when the referral converts to a paid plan, paid while the referred subscription renews for up to two years
entries.payout_terms: Current public page exposes an affiliate performance/commission interface but does not state a public payout threshold, method, or fixed payout cadence in the retrieved content.
entries.eligibility: The program is framed for companies implementing Claap for clients, advisors, influencers and community referrers. Self-referrals and referrals of people working at the same company are excluded.
entries.referral_offer: Current official page says referred users receive 30% off the first two months on monthly plans or 10% off the first year on annual plans.
entries.evidence_summary: Claap's current official affiliate page confirms an active 30% affiliate program with recurring commission for up to two years and an application route separate from its content-post Ambassador rewards.

entries.commission: Up to 25% lifetime monthly recurring revenue for each referred paying customer
entries.payout_terms: Payouts over $100 are processed on the 15th of each month through PartnerStack; cash-out options include PayPal, Stripe, and bank/wire transfer where supported.
entries.eligibility: Current official page says the program is open to professionals and partners promoting business, technology or SaaS content through websites, social channels, newsletters, communities and professional networks. Applications are manually reviewed, typically within one business day.
entries.evidence_summary: CloudTalk currently offers a free PartnerStack affiliate program with up to 25% lifetime MRR, a 90-day cookie, uncapped commissions and monthly payouts after the $100 threshold.

entries.commission: 20%-40% commission for referred new customers during the referred customer's first year; the current page advertises up to 40% with no affiliate earnings cap
entries.payout_terms: Current public affiliate page describes easy PartnerStack payouts but does not expose the exact public payout threshold/cadence in the retrieved text.
entries.eligibility: Current affiliate page explicitly allows promotion through social media, email/newsletters, YouTube, websites, blogs and reviews.
entries.program_separation_note: Seamless also operates a distinct sales-referral program paying gift-card rewards for qualified demos and signed sales-team deals. That referral program requires submitting another person's business contact details and must not be confused with the publisher-style PartnerStack affiliate program.
entries.evidence_summary: Seamless.AI's current official affiliate page confirms a free PartnerStack program paying 20%-40% on referred-customer first-year revenue. Its separate referral-introduction program is kept distinct to avoid submitting personal referral data through the wrong route.

entries.payout_terms: Current official support says affiliate commissions take about 30 days to be approved and that every attributed sale, upgrade and recurring purchase can generate commission after approval.
entries.verification_note: MarketingBlocks' current official support center still lists 'Do You Offer An Affiliate Program?' and a recently updated commission-processing article, proving affiliate functionality remains supported. However, current public first-party material retrieved in this pass did not expose a reliable current commission rate, signup route, payout method or threshold. Do not infer historical third-party terms or auto-apply until the live program enrollment/terms are located.
entries.evidence_summary: MarketingBlocks has current first-party evidence of an affiliate program and commission processing, but the current public commercial terms and enrollment route are incomplete, so it remains needs_manual_verification rather than being falsely marked closed or safely auto-applicable.

entries.commission: Cash payout per new eligible Google Workspace user; exact commission varies by referred account country and edition, with performance-based rates and no annual earnings cap for the Affiliate Program
entries.payout_terms: CJ Affiliate provides affiliate tracking, support and payments. Current Korean official page does not expose one universal commission number because rates vary by country/edition.
entries.eligibility: Google states the Affiliate Program is designed for high-volume referrers and that those referring at least 100 users per year qualify. Applicant review considers performance potential, content quality, relevance and site aesthetics. A separate lower-volume Referral Program is intended for fewer than 100 users per year and is available on Google's Korean site.
entries.routing_note: For COSHUMA, do not automatically choose the high-volume CJ Affiliate path until expected referral volume and applicant-country eligibility are confirmed. The lower-volume Korean Referral Program is a distinct route and cannot be treated as equivalent to the Affiliate Program in the audit/application queue.
entries.evidence_summary: Google Workspace currently has both a free CJ Affiliate Program for high-volume publishers and a separate lower-volume Referral Program. Because the Affiliate path explicitly targets roughly 100+ referred users per year and uses country-specific eligibility/rates, COSHUMA should not be auto-enrolled until route fit is confirmed.
